# `astroYear()` {#fn-astroyear}

**Validation on 2.0.9005.** Build 2.0.9005 passed all 499 calendar, clock, era, angle and setting checks in A01. The largest discrepancy across 240 absolute Julian dates was 0.000021 seconds. [A01 results](a01-calendar-checks.qmd).

[Function index](function-index.html#idx-astroyear)

```{=html}
<p>Astronomical years include zero. Historical BC or BCE years convert
by subtracting the historical year from one. AD and CE years keep their value.
Era labels are case-insensitive and follow a positive whole year.
</p>
```

**Interpretation and limits.** When an excavation report gives 1 BC, the corresponding astronomical year is zero. Convert the year once before computing an ephemeris. An off-by-one year can survive a round trip through calendar formatting if both ends use the same mistaken convention.
